name: Iga Świątek
intro: Iga Świątek is a champion from Poland. She has won six Grand Slam titles, the biggest trophies in tennis. One was right here at the US Open in 2022.
story: Iga's dad rowed in the Olympics for Poland. She picked tennis and worked very hard. She has been world number 1 for 125 weeks in total. She wins lots of 6-0 sets, which fans call bagels. So they call her Iga's Bakery!

funFacts.text: Her favorite meal is pasta with strawberries. Yes, really!
She loves building LEGO sets. It helps her stay calm and focused.
LEGO once gave her a giant strawberry made from 3,000 bricks.
She warms up to loud rock music like AC/DC and Led Zeppelin.
She has a cat named Grappa. LEGO even made a tiny Grappa figure for her!
She started tennis to beat her big sister Agata. Agata is a dentist now!
Her forehand spins the ball more than 3,400 times a minute. That is like Rafael Nadal!

watchFor: Watch her spinny forehand dip, then jump up high off the court.
